title: Bank of England MPC decision — Summary and minutes only, no Monetary Policy Report (12:00 London / 08:00 ET) — the round that votes the day the Fed publishes its SEP and misses the February CPI print by six days
source: EST: bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy/upcoming-mpc-dates, re-fetched direct 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200) by the lane writing this canonical file — the page's 2027 panel is headed 'Provisional Dates' and lists 'Thursday 4 February — February MPC Summary and minutes and February Monetary Policy Report', 'Thursday 18 March — March MPC Summary and minutes', 'Thursday 29 April — April MPC Summary and minutes and April Monetary Policy Report', 'Thursday 17 June', 'Thursday 29 July', 'Thursday 16 September', 'Thursday 4 November', 'Thursday 16 December'. The 18 March row carries 'MPC Summary and minutes' and NO Monetary Policy Report; the same page's 2026 panel, headed 'Confirmed Dates', gives the exact analogue 'Thursday 19 March — March MPC Summary and minutes'. Filed estimate on three counts: the Bank calls its own 2027 dates PROVISIONAL (a real caveat, not a taxonomy artefact — its 2026 dates are labelled confirmed on the same page), this lane may not self-confirm an event it wrote, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: and no slot for a non-Fed central bank. Written 2026-09-10 as the canonical file for an id that existed only as two sibling proposals (proposals/boe-decision-2027-03-18.from-uk-cpi-2027-04-21.json and .from-uk-labour-market-2027-01-19.json), both read in full first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN 2026-09-10 from two sibling proposals, WITH THREE CORRECTIONS, each mechanical rather than a judgement call. (1) KIND rates -> macro-print. Both proposals filed kind 'rates'. On this calendar 'rates' means bond-auction and rates-market plumbing: all 118 entries carrying it are JGB/Bund/gilt auctions, liquidity-enhancement operations and SIFMA bond sessions, and NOT ONE is a central-bank decision. Every central-bank decision here — boe-decision-2026-09-17, -2026-11-05, -2026-12-17, -2027-04-29 and boj-decision-2027-03-18 — is macro-print. (2) IMPACT low/medium -> medium. The proposals split (the uk-cpi lane said low, the uk-labour-market lane said medium). Medium, on boe-decision-2027-04-29's own stated precedent: the 'no instrument, symbols: []' reasoning is correct and is exactly why the CALL is a stand-aside at high confidence, but it applies identically to all five sibling decision entries, every one of which is medium. Tiering one class two ways buys no safety and makes the cadence incoherent (low screens every 30d, medium every 21d until D-31). (3) CLOCK 07:00 ET -> 08:00 ET. The uk-labour-market proposal's title said 07:00 ET; the uk-cpi proposal said 08:00 ET and is right. 2027-03-18 falls inside the two-week transatlantic DST gap — US EDT starts 2027-03-14 (second Sunday), UK BST not until 2027-03-28 (last Sunday) — so London is on GMT while New York is on EDT and 12:00 London is 08:00 ET, one hour later than this meeting's usual US-morning slot. WHY THIS ROUND IS WORTH A LEDGER, and it is structural rather than a rate view: it is the LEANEST and BLINDEST document set the Bank produces. No Monetary Policy Report, and on the 2026 analogue (19 March 2026, fetched direct 2026-09-10) the announcement published one document — 'Monetary Policy Summary and minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee meeting ending on 18 March 2026' — with no Report, no Agents' summary and no press conference. Its inflation picture is the JANUARY CPI print of 2027-02-17, 29 days old, because the FEBRUARY print lands 2027-03-24, SIX DAYS AFTER this meeting (ons.gov.uk/releases/consumerpriceinflationukfebruary2027, fetched 2026-09-10: 'Provisional release date: 24 March 2027 7:00am'). That is not a 2027 quirk: the ONS's two-stage weights update, introduced from 2025, moved the February bulletin late into March, and the gap has been exactly six days three years running (MPC 2025-03-20 vs CPI 2025-03-26; MPC 2026-03-19 vs CPI 2026-03-25; MPC 2027-03-18 vs CPI 2027-03-24 provisional), against minus one day in 2024 under the old one-stage update. And the MPC votes at a meeting ENDING THE DAY BEFORE the announcement — verified on three BoE primaries — so this Committee votes on 2027-03-17, the day fomc-2027-03-17 publishes the first SEP of 2027 at 14:00 ET / 18:00 London. NOT OURS TO TRADE: symbols: [], no UK listing, gilt or sterling instrument on this calendar, and no rates- or FX-keyed house playbook. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action. PROMOTION CRITERION: the Bank moving its 2027 dates from provisional to confirmed.
